changelog:
nuwa-dual-mode 1.0.0

- Initial release of the "女娲造人术·Dual-Mode" skill.
- Enables distilling any person or theme into a runnable "perspective skill" supporting both Persona (first-person) and Toolkit (third-person) modes, with single-mode available for pure methodology themes.
- Provides detailed step-by-step workflow, strict process checkpoints, and robust architecture/quality constraints.
- Features automatic intent inference (no follow-up questions), multi-region hotline coverage, and transparent source policies for Chinese/Western/dual-language figures.
- Introduces a comprehensive care protocol when emotional support may be needed, including dynamic "关怀红线".
- Ensures every skill includes mode selection logic, mode table/use instructions, intent matrix, timeless statements, and clear module separation for dual-mode architecture.
